name: multi-file-edit
setup:
printf 'def total(a, b):
    return a + b
' > math_utils.py && printf 'from math_utils import total

print(total(100, 200))
' > app.py && printf 'from math_utils import total

def invoice():
    return total(50, 25)
' > report.py
prompt: Change the function total() in math_utils.py to take three parameters (a, b, tax) and return (a + b) * (1 + tax). Update both call sites (app.py and report.py) to pass a tax argument, so that `python3 app.py` and importing report still work.
verify: grep -Eq 'def total\(a, b, tax\)' math_utils.py && grep -Eq 'total\([^,()]+,[^,()]+,[^,()]+\)' app.py && grep -Eq 'total\([^,()]+,[^,()]+,[^,()]+\)' report.py && python3 app.py > /dev/null && python3 -c 'import report; report.invoice()'
